purpose: Deterministically map final P3 state-count and, only when triggered, same-partition evidence into a purpose map and formal closeout.

deterministic_mapping.comparator_reached: Minimum tested state count and placement are copied from the state-count result; CURRENT_LAYER_FACE is reported sufficient only within the frozen numerical-comparator envelope.
deterministic_mapping.closure_deficit_supported: Report CURRENT_LAYER_FACE insufficient relative to same-partition Richards for that tested case; do not admit a replacement closure.

future_execution_binding_requirements: Persisted P3 state-count result is mandatory.
If same_partition_richards_triggers is non-empty, persisted P3 same-partition result is mandatory.
If no trigger exists, closeout must not require or invent a same-partition result.
Binding must freeze exact evidence and builder/workflow blobs.
Closeout may recommend a separate closure workstream only for cases already classified CLOSURE_DEFICIT_SUPPORTED.
